description: This file contains an extension of the ChannelsStore class, adding asynchronous methods for loading and applying configuration schemas and values, as well as helper functions for manipulating nested configuration data.

methods.name: loadConfigSchema
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the configuration schema from a remote gateway and updates the local schema and UI hints.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Fetches the current configuration snapshot asynchronously, updates internal state, and applies UI settings.

methods.name: applyUIConfig
methods.description: Applies UI-specific configuration such as the seam color from a configuration snapshot.

methods.name: channelConfigSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration schema node for a specific channel ID.

methods.name: configValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value at a specified path, with fallback logic for channel-specific configurations.

methods.name: updateConfigValue
methods.description: Updates the draft configuration with a new value at a specified path, marking the draft as dirty.

methods.name: saveConfigDraft
methods.description: Saves the current draft configuration asynchronously and reloads the configuration upon success.

methods.name: reloadConfigDraft
methods.description: Reloads the configuration from the remote source, effectively discarding unsaved draft changes.
